meta.purpose: In-season NBA head-coach changes for 2023-24 and 2024-25, with the effective date, for the K1 coach-rotation factor. A mid-season change reshuffles the minutes distribution, which the baseline cannot see from box scores alone.
meta.method: Names parsed from the Wikipedia season pages (caption 'Coaching changes', in-season section). DATES were NOT scraped - team infobox formats vary too much and only 1 of 7 parsed. They are verified here against multiple independent sources and recorded with a confidence flag, because this is a fixed set of seven historical facts that will never change: hand-verified beats a fragile scraper.
meta.2025-26: already dated in nba_coach_changes.json (POR Billups->Splitter 2025-10-23, NOP Green->Borrego 2025-11-15)
meta.usage: effective_date is the first date the NEW coach is in charge. Games strictly before it belong to the outgoing coach. Verify against the team game log before relying on it for a specific game.

changes.note: Rivers 17-19 the rest of the way; second change for the same team in four days
Unseld Jr. moved to a front-office advisory role in January 2024; Keefe interim for the rest of the season
Vaughn fired Monday 2024-02-19 at 21-33 over the All-Star break; Ollie's FIRST GAME was Thursday 2024-02-22 vs Toronto - the effective date is the first game, not the announcement
Popovich suffered a stroke on 2024-11-02 and did not return; Johnson took over as interim. Date needs a final check against the game log
